body: American Airlines temporarily suspended its nonstop route to Doha when the war broke out, and confirmed its permanent cancellation in June. American first began serving Doha, its only Middle Eastern destination at the time, in 2022 from New York JFK Airport and then switched its US port to Philadelphia the following year. The main reason for the route was connectivity with fellow oneworld member Qatar Airways.

Qatar Airways formerly flew to Philadelphia with its own aircraft before American took over the route, and as the two have a codeshare agreement, the route essentially continued with an American Boeing 787. At the same time, Qatar Airways added a third nonstop frequency between Doha and JFK that would operate four times per week, bringing weekly frequencies to JFK from 14 to 18 flights per week. In August, Qatar Airways began daily flights between Doha and Philadelphia with an Airbus A350, while it will be ending its third JFK flight at the end of October.

Qatar Airways now serves 12 destinations in the US: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas/Fort Worth, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, New York-JFK, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington. It is notably the only Middle Eastern airline serving Philadelphia, and the airport is important because it serves as American's primary transatlantic hub, with a substantial connecting network to feed these flights. The Philadelphia-Doha flight therefore essentially functions as a long-haul hub-to-hub flight, regardless of which airline operates it.
en.summary: After American Airlines suspended its Philadelphia-Doha route and confirmed in June that it would not return, Qatar Airways began daily Doha-Philadelphia flights with an Airbus A350 in August and will end its third Doha-New York JFK flight at the end of October, reallocating capacity to its earlier layout.
en.title: Qatar Airways rebalances US East Coast flying as American Airlines exits Doha for good

body: 美國航空於2022年先從紐約甘迺迪開航杜哈航線，隔年將美國端改為費城；該航線當時是美國航空唯一的中東航點，主要目的在於銜接同為寰宇一家成員的卡達航空。戰爭爆發後美國航空暫停費城往返杜哈航線，並於6月確認永久取消，費城旅客因此一度面臨失去中東直飛服務的可能。
卡達航空原本就曾以自家飛機飛航費城，在美國航空接手後雙方以共用班號方式維持該航線；卡達航空同時曾將杜哈往返紐約甘迺迪航線從每週14班增至18班，第三班每週飛航4班。今年8月卡達航空開始以A350每日飛航杜哈往返費城，並將於10月底結束第三班紐約甘迺迪航線，實質上是把運能調回美國航空開航杜哈之前的配置。
目前卡達航空在美國服務12個航點，包括亞特蘭大、波士頓、芝加哥、達拉斯沃斯堡、休士頓、洛杉磯、邁阿密、紐約甘迺迪、費城、舊金山、西雅圖與華盛頓；費城是美國航空主要的跨大西洋樞紐，轉機網絡可為杜哈航線帶來客源，杜哈往返費城航線因此兼具兩端樞紐對飛的性質。
